OOH BRAND LIFT POWERPLAY 2026

From Exposure to Impact: Who Will Own OOH’s Outcome-Intelligence Layer?

OOH has already digitized the screen.

The next challenge is digitizing the intelligence behind the screen.

The industry is moving from:

Delivery → Exposure → Brand Lift → Business Outcome → Optimization

Global OOH reached $54.2B in 2025, with DOOH at $25.5B. Yet programmatic DOOH represented only 7% of global DOOH in the WOO/PwC 2025 benchmark.

THE DATA BEHIND THE BILLBOARD - U.S. MARKET DEEP DIVE

OOH/DOOH is no longer just about screens, locations and impressions.

The real transformation is happening underneath -through mobility data, location intelligence, audience signals, measurement, attribution and optimization.
In my latest research, I explored how the U.S. OOH/DOOH ecosystem is evolving from:

Measurement → Exposure Intelligence → Attribution → Optimization 

I looked at the roles of Geopath, Ipsos, Foursquare, Veraset, Unacast, Precisely/PlaceIQ, Adsquare, Cuebiq, Placer.ai, Comscore and Lumen Research, and how these different data layers connect with planning, DSP/SSP activation and campaign measurement.

The bigger question is not who has the most data?
